correction: The forky publish-to-r2 call kept the action default html-index: true. repogen writes each index.html from the local files only and its metadata sync excludes every published payload, so the forky publish would replace the shared ext/ browser indexes and drop the trixie links that the build job had just written. The forky publish now sets html-index: false.
evidence: Cross-review of PR #1308 at d25ed33, finding 1: repogen b5dccc7 .github/actions/publish-to-r2/action.yml (html-index default true; sysext sync excludes *.raw*), internal/cli/generate.go dirindex.Generate, internal/dirindex/dirindex.go (index from os.ReadDir). test/build-workflow-permissions-test.py fails when the line is removed or set to true.
